newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian oil marketers firm in active stock trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian oil marketers firm in active stock trade.

text.p: Oil marketing shares retained their appeal among Nigerian investors on Tuesday, buoyed by an improved third quarter result by Agip, dealers said.
The all-index index closed at 7572.94, up from 7538.45 on Monday.
The market recorded one deal worth 500,000 naira in the rarely traded federal government stocks but equities remained the focus of attraction.
Agip delighted traders when it posted a better profit after tax for the period to end-September 1996 compared to the profit a year ago.
The company announced it netted 169 million naira against 119.7 million naira by end-September 1995, sending its shares 35 kobo up to 28.50 naira.
Other oil shares did well on the presumption that they would fare better this year, said one broker.
"The result coming from Agip was a psychological booster for the sector because investors will now expect others to follow with improved performances," he added.
Total was 69.00 naira, up 30 kobo, Unipetrol
